in_arabic.name: زاليک
in_arabic.long_meaning: زاليک هو اسم عربي مشتق من الفعل زال أي أصبح حكيمًا، ويتعلق بالحكمة والفهم العميق، وهو اسم ذو دلالة إيجابية في التراث الإسلامي، ويتعلق بالعقل والفكر الصحيح

in_urdu.name: زалиک
in_urdu.long_meaning: زالیک ایک عربي نام ہے جو حکمت اور سمجھ بوجھ سے متعلق ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی روایات میں положیتو معنی رکھتا ہے، اور عقل اور درست فکر سے متعلق ہے

in_hindi.name: ज़ालिक
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़ालिक एक अरबी नाम है जो बुद्धिमत्ता और समझ से संबंधित है, और यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में सकारात्मक अर्थ रखता है, और बुद्धि और सही विचार से संबंधित है

in_pashto.name: زاليک
in_pashto.long_meaning: زاليک د عربي نوم دی چې د حکمت او समझ سره اړیکه لري، او دا نوم په اسلامي روایت کې مثبت معنا لري، او عقل او صحيح فکر سره اړیکه لري

in_english.name: Zaalik
in_english.meaning: one who possesses wisdom and understanding
in_english.long_meaning: Zaalik is an Arabic name derived from the root z-a-l, meaning to possess wisdom and understanding, and it carries a positive connotation in Islamic tradition, relating to intellect and correct thinking, and is associated with spiritual growth and enlightenment

data.cultural_impact: The name Zaalik has roots in the Islamic tradition, being derived from the Arabic word for gazelle. In Middle Eastern and North African cultures, gazelles have long been revered for their grace and beauty. Naming a child Zaalik would not only be a nod to this traditional cultural appreciation for elegance and gentleness but could also serve as a reminder for parents and family to strive for these virtues in everyday life.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic theology, the gazelle has been symbolically connected to various spiritual concepts. For example, a hadith (saying of Prophet Muhammad) describes the believers in heaven as having the faces of gazelles, which may symbolize their gentle and radiant countenance reflecting the presence of God. The metaphorical likeness of the child bearing this name to the graceful and agile gazelle may serve as a reminder for the individual to be gentle, elegant, and persistent in their spiritual journey.
